summary: Iteration 8 — Books & Audiobooks agent + AuthGate (operator-only, currently open) + OCI bootstrap. Backend: 87/87 pytest tests PASS (67 regression + 6 TestBooks light + 10 NEW TestBooksE2E with real Emergent LLM Gemini-3-Flash chapter generation + 4 TestAuth). Frontend live on https://gmaos-control.preview.emergentagent.com: sidebar 'Books & Audiobooks' link reachable, /books renders with 4 stat tiles (Books/Total Words/Downloads/Audiobook-Ready), 'Generate Book' button opens dialog with Title/Type/Tone/Audience/Chapters/Words/Outline fields and submit, AuthGate falls OPEN because OPERATOR_EMAIL is unset (verified via /api/auth/config returning {required: false}). All 3 OCI scripts (oci-bootstrap.sh, deploy-local.sh, validate-oci.sh) pass bash -n and are executable. Real book creation E2E (2-chapter manual via Emergent LLM) completed in ~25s, produced status=complete, 2 chapters, total_word_count > 0, rev-books revenue stream auto-created idempotently, .md and .txt downloads return correct content-type + attachment header, delete works. Auth invalid-session returns 401 (not 500), logout idempotent.
critical_code_review_comments: books.py: Synchronous book generation blocks the request for 30-90s. For a 6-chapter book this risks proxy/ingress 60s timeouts. Consider returning the drafting row immediately + running generation as a background task (FastAPI BackgroundTasks or asyncio.create_task) and polling status. Acceptable as-is for small books (chapter_count<=3) the user clicks themselves; flag if you ever raise the default chapter_count.

books.py: _ensure_books_stream is idempotent via find_one+insert_one — but two concurrent first-book requests could race and double-insert. Switching to update_one(upsert=True) on the same id key would be race-safe (low-priority — currently single operator).

auth.py: Session cookie uses samesite=none + secure=true — correct for cross-site preview domain. Cookie path=/ + httponly — good. exchange_session correctly converts upstream non-200 into 401 (NOT 500) so the test suite stays green.

auth.py: When OPERATOR_EMAIL is unset, _ensure_allowed silently allows ANY Google login through (first-logged-in becomes operator). Document this in README so a user doesn't accidentally deploy to a public domain without setting OPERATOR_EMAIL.

Books.js: Audiobook playback uses window.speechSynthesis with no fallback for browsers that disable it (Safari mobile sometimes blocks). Consider showing a tooltip or disabling the button when speechSynthesis.getVoices() returns []. Non-blocking.

Books.js Generate dialog: the chapter_count input has no max attribute matching the backend's MAX_CHAPTER_COUNT=20 — a user can type 999 and hit a 400 from the backend. Add max={20} on the input for nicer UX (very minor).
AuthGate.js correctly polls /api/auth/config and falls open when required=false — verified live.
